hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */maps/*.asm|*/engine/*.asm) out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 utils/dialogue_lint.py "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */data/trainers/parties.asm|*/data/pokemon/evos_attacks*.asm|*/data/pokemon/base_stats.asm|*/data/pokemon/base_stats/*.asm|*/data/pokemon/safari_move_tutor_moves.asm) out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 utils/trainer_lint.py --errors-only --suggest --new-vs HEAD 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
